whenToUse: A full screen opens from an icon or card.
You show it returning to its original place after closing.
The same kind of screen opens from several entry points.
whenNotToUse: The opened screen has no relation to the pressed element.
Wide desktop screens where a big zoom can cause motion sickness.
The pressed element itself should grow (use a shared element transition).

alternatives.name: Shared Element Transition
alternatives.reason: The same object is on both screens.

alternatives.name: Page Transition
alternatives.reason: Going deeper from a list into details.

accessibility: On open, focus goes to the Home button; on close, it returns to the icon that was pressed.
While open, the icons behind are inert, so Tab doesn't enter them.
With reduced motion, it opens and closes without zooming.
The opened screen gets a name with aria-label.
